determinism.method: two in-process runs of the same seeded sim: fresh Rapier world per run, LCG seed 1264010580 (0x4b574554) derives a 6-impulse scripted schedule (ticks 60/157/254/351/448/545), 600 fixed steps dt=1/60, Z-up, gravity (0,0,-9.80665), Rapier defaults, friction 0.7/restitution 0; state stream = 21 snapshots (every 30 steps + final) x 3 bodies x [t,v,q] hashed as sha256 over raw IEEE-754 f64 bit patterns of the solver's f32-promoted values (no float formatting involved); secondary sha256 over JSON.stringify shortest-round-trip text
